answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a refundable work-bond per identity, released only after a cooling window of peer-attested jobs. Until the bond is posted and attestations accrue, the agent cannot grade or route value. Auditors run a periodic raven sample over funding graphs and answer hashes; if identities share a payer or reuse text, every linked bond is slashed into a shared lagoon that reimburses the attestors who caught them. A public lantern of those slash receipts lets counterparts refuse unattested clones. Each extra fake identity costs a full bond and risks losing the cluster.
